output.review_comment: The code correctly passes all 10 tests and properly implements the three fixes needed: (1) correct "started periods" calculation, (2) round-half-up behavior, and (3) ensure the cap respects the minimum fee. However, the implementation contradicts the docstring statement "The cap always wins, even when it brings the fee below the minimum fee." The actual behavior (minimum fee takes precedence) is correct per the tests, which encode the finance spec. The docstring should be updated to reflect that the minimum fee floor applies even when the one-fifth cap would be lower, but this is a documentation fix outside the scope of the current request.
